claims.statement: Management believes that within the next two to three years, existing stores will generate sufficient capital to fund expansion without further borrowing.

claims.statement: Management expects LFL growth for the coming financial year to be in the range of 7.5% to 8%.
claims.quote: is that in the coming financial year, we see that this is something which is, possible for us to deliver.

claims.statement: Management plans to first prove the 6-hour delivery model in 11 cities before considering further expansion of DMart Ready.
claims.quote: our approach would be to make sure that this 6-hour delivery model, we are able to prove in these 11 cities and then once we are able to do that, then we will take it further up.

claims.statement: Management states there is no current plan to introduce a full-fledged fresh portfolio in DMart stores.
claims.quote: is there a plan to have a full-fledged fresh portfolio in DMart stores at this point of time? No.

claims.statement: Management states they are not looking at quicker delivery formats (like quick commerce) as an option for DMart Ready.
claims.quote: No, Vivek. We are not looking at that as an option.
